generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The tenderer has to furnish the details of the Head Office including Telephone No.s, E-mail address, the fax and the mobile numbers of the person whom to be contacted.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The employer is not responsible for any technical hiccups or delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original, Submit the original document at the time of technical bid opening or next day and the Executive Director reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval.

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Director, 8, M S B-1, 6th & 7th Floor, Cunningham Road, Bangalore-52 during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday , the next working day will be considered
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value, it will be calculated as per the STD tender document Attached.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
Tenderer who qualifying in the technical bid such tenderer financial bid will be opened.

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder.
The Defect liability period of the work is 12 Months from the date of submision of final bill.
Terms and condition of Contract as per Approved STD KW-1.
The rates are Exclusive of GST. GST will be paid seperately.
The Bidder should agree and give a consent letter to the condition that, if Borewell failed No Water No Money.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tenderer shall have valid class-IV and Above KPWD/CPWD/MES/Railways/Public sectors licence.
The tenderer has to furnish Company Profile and details of Technical Personnel working/Associated with him the qualification and experience of individual are to be mentioned
Tenderer has to furnish Annual turnover for the last 5 years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Duly certified by CA with UDIN.
Achieved in at least TWO financial years a minimum financial turnover in all classes of civil engineering construction works only of Rs 4.96 Lakhs. Duly certified by CA with UDIN.

Tenderer should Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, atleast one similar work such as Building work of value not less than Rs 2.48 Lakhs. The workdone certificate duly signed not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
The Bidder should agree and give a consent letter to the condition that, if Borewell failed No Water No Money.

itemList.description: Geophysical investigation at site for sinking borewells for supplying drinking water to the habitation either through the Hand Pump MWS or P.W.S.S, by vertical electrical sounding by adopting Venner or Schlumbergers’s method, including reconnaissance survey of geological formation. Geophysical investigation of existing ground water in the vicinity, its quality, quantity and acceptability of the users, indicating the location of the site, recommended depth of casing pipe required to seal the top unconsolidated formation including an extra depth of 1.0 metre in consolidated formation for proper seating of casing pipe, depthof drilling required to cover full depth of aquifer proposed to be tapped, probable yield and other information required including transportation of instruments and accessories to work site, engaging technical personal and labour required etc. NOTE: 1)       Additional rate on item 1&2 is allowed for drilling in over burden and fixing Casing pipes beyond 20 M (for fixing Casing pipes only) a) Above 20 M and upto 30 M - 15%, b) Above 30 M - 30% (Measurement of overburden is restricted to the depth of casing pipe fixed excluding initial depth of 20M and projection above ground level). 2)   A sum of Rs. 100/- is to be deducted for Dry Borewell towards yield test. ---- Including all lead and lift charges, loading and unloading charges, labour charges, all incidental charges, hire charges of all men and machinery and equipments required for successful completion of work etc., complete. The work shall be executed as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Sinking of Borewell of 165mm dia clear using super fast hydraulic rig of capacity 300 PSIG & above 1100 CMF & above in all strata including over burdern upto 20 m.
